text: Entry 1364 adds a 27-line EmailSyncAccountsForm class that only guards repeated connection and clones the sync template. The local class has no captureState implementation or resource-selection construction. At the fixed accepted endpoint, the same element family has checked/enabled URL selection and a reset lifecycle, covered by the later sync-resource lessons. Keep the original shell dated: custom-element registration and a template do not establish completed selection or synchronization behavior. This is a scoped architectural observation.
